text: Live is already selected: in your screenshot the Live segment shows a check mark and is highlighted, and a selected segment can't be tapped again (that's why it does nothing). The engine's status also reads Trading LIVE. To change mode tap Paper or Off. If you want to confirm GitHub is betting, the Engine tab shows 'Trading LIVE' and the last pass; the engine only orders 8 am to 1 am Eastern and orders will resume after its new job's first scan.
